function: DQN-based DRL selects the radar/communication power fraction mu jointly with task partition and service-vehicle selection (above PHY); the power split is an ISAC resource, p. 1 and p. 7.
notes: Excluded for system (area 5 by function). The DRL (DQN-Regu, DDQN-Regu, DQN-Regu with TL) learns the radar/communication power fraction jointly with task partition and service-vehicle choice (p. 1: "we optimize the fractions of power allocated to the radar and communication functions"; action space, p. 7), so above_phy and function are passed. But the link has no antenna array, beamforming or RIS: antennas appear only as scalar gains (p. 5: "Gtx,com is the transmitting antenna gain of the task vehicle"; p. 6; Table II, p. 11) and the rate is a single-link Shannon formula (p. 5, Eq. 3). Borderline: Table II (p. 11) lists only mu1 = 0.7 and mu2 = 0.9; if the reviewer judges this power split too minor, the work is above_phy (task offloading with coded computing).
